overall_summary: Dataset is small, with view counts generally ranging between 100-350, except for one significant outlier about husband-wife dynamics reaching 1,655 views. Family and relationship topics perform noticeably better than pure abstract shayari.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife-husband emotional video ('or5gtaBpRVY') achieved 1,655 views, while relationship reality ('NO5fdHLxFL4') and family content (Maa, Papa, Relatives) consistently pull 100-300 views.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more narratives on complex relationship bonds, marital understandings, and everyday family sacrifices.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Sister/Sibling Tropes with Low Differentiation
weak_patterns.evidence: First sister video ('jfmMztnam_A') got 18 views and a repeat attempt ('fAAoIQCRMXU') got 130 views, indicating low immediate pull compared to parental or spousal dynamics.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid repeating identical sibling hooks without a fresh narrative angle.
